title: Foundations of Hyperbolic Manifolds
note: Source (§4.6–4.7) for the classification of totally-geodesic planes of the upper half-space model $H^3$: they are exactly the Euclidean vertical planes and the Euclidean hemispheres centred on the boundary $\partial H^3$. Adopted as the concrete geodesic-plane model in `QOU.Archimedean.IdealBoundaryGeodesicPlane` (the single cited geometric input of the T2 ideal-tetrahedron development; not proved from a Riemannian metric, which Mathlib 4.24.0 lacks).
